notes.title: Developer Livestream 2
notes.notes:
[h2]Livestream[/h2]
The Voice Inside is a psychological horror adventure game with different & challenging game control types. Use the voice-control, or a unique controller & keyboard system to give the right commands & move freely through a dark & abstract world. Try To Escape The Darkness!

[b]Let's have fun together, playing with all different control types, like the Voice-control, to explore a dark and atmospheric game world![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34564098/a129b0ce9dac7acfa69f1c0c0aa6d29619fb8fbe.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 4
notes.notes:
Here is a new update for you!
We are still here, and we put a lot of time and effort into our big update 2020 during the lock down to make a rapid progress. We still need time to make the game ready for Early Access in 2021! But for now, we keep spending a lot of time developing & preparing the game. We will give you some more updates, soon! 😊
Stay tuned & healthy guys! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34564098/1c05e0cbb3dac2c488bb77360d565a3318e494ab.png[/img]

notes.title: Plans for 2020
notes.notes:
Hey there, here comes a new update!

We hope you had a happy new year. 

For us,[b][i] 2019[/i][/b] has been a huge journey, bringing our first game dev project to life, up to a playable demo version, which we could show on several great events! 
So, what comes next? 
The new year comes with a lot of ideas and big decisions. 
For 2020 the plan is to keep improving the game, implement more content, upgrade the game mechanics and the speech recognition, to give [i][b]The Voice Inside[/b][/i] more fullness.
For these plans, [i][b]we’ve decided to take more development time in 2020[/b][/i], as we’ve had already hinted. Thank you for your support. 

Stay tuned for updates in 2020.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34564098/ac1be96dbabe789e51b7cac94add8a8493f2dda2.jpg[/img]
